title: TTS timeline is a track source, not inline subtitle words
given: A tts track points to an mp3 and a timeline.json file.
then: The subtitle_timeline track loads words from timeline.json, and the subtitle track renders from that timeline.

ai_tools.command: NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf composition show --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-clip-first | jq '[.source.tracks[] | select(.kind=="subtitle")][0].clips[0].params.source.words | length'
